title: Watchface, widget and notifications take time to update
symptom: When AAPS receives xDrip's data it updates, but widget, watchface and notification take time to update (sometimes 1-3 minutes, watchface even 15-20 minutes). This causes alarms from xDrip to show a different value on the watch.
cause: The issue was likely caused by the amount of user data stored in the app, as suggested by a comment referencing issue #2036.
fix: Checking and reducing the amount of user data stored in the app resolved the issue.
evidence_quote: Might be worth checking how much user data the app has stored?
